description: Imam Bayildi is a classic Turkish dish featuring whole eggplants stuffed with a rich, aromatic filling of onions, tomatoes, garlic, and herbs. Slow-cooked in olive oil, the eggplant becomes incredibly tender, melting in your mouth with every bite. This vegetarian delight is a testament to the vibrant flavors of Mediterranean cuisine, perfect as a main course or a flavorful side.

instructions.title: Prepare the Eggplants
instructions.text: Wash the eggplants. Peel them partially in stripes, leaving some skin on. Make a deep lengthwise slit in each eggplant, being careful not to cut all the way through. Sprinkle salt generously inside the slits and on the skin. Let them sit for 20 minutes to draw out bitter juices, then rinse thoroughly and pat dry with paper towels.

instructions.title: Fry the Eggplants
instructions.text: Heat about 1/4 cup of olive oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Fry the eggplants in batches until they are golden brown and softened on all sides. This usually takes about 3-4 minutes per side. Remove them from the pan and place them on paper towels to drain excess oil. Preheat your oven to 180C (350F).

instructions.title: Prepare the Filling
instructions.text: In the same pan, add another 1/4 cup of olive oil. Saute the chopped onions over medium heat until translucent and slightly caramelized, about 5-7 minutes. Add the chopped green bell pepper and minced garlic, cooking for another 3 minutes until fragrant. Stir in the diced tomatoes, tomato paste diluted in water, sugar, salt, pepper, chopped parsley, and dill (if using). Cook for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sauce thickens slightly.

instructions.title: Stuff the Eggplants
instructions.text: Gently open the slits in each fried eggplant. Spoon the prepared filling generously into each eggplant cavity. Arrange the stuffed eggplants in a baking dish. Pour the remaining 1/2 cup of water into the bottom of the baking dish around the eggplants.

instructions.title: Bake Imam Bayildi
instructions.text: Cover the baking dish with aluminum foil and bake in the preheated oven for 20 minutes. Remove the foil and continue baking for another 10-15 minutes, or until the eggplants are very tender and the filling is bubbly and slightly browned on top. The olive oil should be shimmering.

instructions.title: Serve and Enjoy
instructions.text: Remove from the oven and let the Imam Bayildi cool down for at least 15-20 minutes before serving; it tastes even better warm or at room temperature. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve with lemon wedges. It pairs wonderfully with plain yogurt or a simple rice pilaf.

tips: For less oil, you can bake or grill the eggplants instead of frying them. Brush with olive oil before baking at 200C (400F) for 20-25 minutes until soft.
Always use good quality olive oil for Imam Bayildi as it is a key flavor component. Extra virgin olive oil adds richness.
Imam Bayildi is traditionally served at room temperature, allowing the flavors to fully meld. It can be prepared a day in advance and tastes even better the next day.
